# Observable degrees of freedom (rank of the map from the inputs to each stage)

SHA-256 of the conditions: `63cd7758110e8113`. 4 points × 3 seeds. The rank is the number of singular values whose
ratio to the largest singular value exceeds 1e-06.

| Map | Output | Rank (min–max over the 12 cases) | Range of the smallest relative singular value |
|---|---|---|---|
| two_inputs | H | 2–2 | 1.7e-02–6.1e-02 |
| two_inputs | minmax | 2–2 | 2.1e-03–7.6e-03 |
| two_inputs | desc_H | 2–2 | 2.3e-04–7.0e-03 |
| two_inputs | desc_minmax | 2–2 | 4.8e-05–1.0e-02 |
| three_inputs | H | 3–3 | 1.1e-03–4.1e-03 |
| three_inputs | minmax | 2–2 | 3.2e-14–9.7e-14 |
| three_inputs | desc_H | 2–2 | 2.3e-04–8.9e-03 |
| three_inputs | desc_minmax | 2–2 | 6.8e-05–1.3e-02 |
